verdict.rationale: LanceDB's own docs state that it provides native BM25 keyword full-text search via Lance. They also show building an FTS index directly on a table column (create_fts_index), with incremental reindexing of FTS indexes, so no separate search engine is needed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of FTS quality and behavior, and deeper documentation detail in the evidence (tokenizers, phrase queries).

support.subject: As a developer, I can run keyword/full-text search over documents inside the database without bolting on a separate search engine

citations.quote: LanceDB provides support for Full-Text Search via Lance, allowing you to incorporate keyword-based search (based on BM25) in your retrieval solutions.
Reindexing is the process of updating the index to account for new data -- this applies to either a full-text search (FTS) index or a vector index.
